pages.title: Cute Halloween Pumpkins Floating in Hot Air Balloon Above Farm Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows two cute Halloween pumpkins floating in a hot air balloon above a farm, waving from a basket under a pumpkin-shaped canopy. Both riders wear pointed hats and scarves, with bunting around the basket and balloon. Broad canopy panels contrast with narrow ropes, woven basket lines, and small pumpkins in the fields below.

pages.title: Cute Halloween Cat Polishing Crystal Ball in Fortune Tent Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute Halloween cat polishes a crystal ball in a fortune tent in this printable coloring page, holding a cloth beside the star-filled round globe. Moons and stars decorate its pointed hat, neckerchief, curtains, and tablecloth. The coloring sheet combines large fabric folds with smaller details in the hanging lantern, potion jars, book, and framed cat picture.

pages.title: Cute Halloween Monsters Building Candy Castle in Playroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows three cute Halloween monsters building a candy castle in a playroom, arranging cupcakes, candy canes, and lollipops around its towers. A stitched monster, vampire, and mummy work beside cookie walls and stacked sweets, with toys behind them. The coloring sheet combines broad castle sections with small frosting swirls, gummy bears, and candy stripes.

pages.title: Cute Halloween Ghosts Singing on Moonlit Garden Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Three cute Halloween ghosts sing on a moonlit garden stage in this printable coloring page, gathering at microphones beneath a smiling crescent moon and decorative arch. A bow tie and witch hat distinguish two singers, while curtains frame their broad outlines. The coloring sheet adds small stars, leafy branches, microphone grilles, and wooden stage planks.
